scope: Read the cumulative builder, preservation baseline, revised tests, and ledger/similarity date changes; execute read-only builds and targeted in-memory preservation probes. New question legal/editorial quality and real HTTP behavior are outside this code review.

baseline_verification.method: Read actual Git object with git show, hash original bank bytes and canonical JSON of every question/source, compare authoring-file bytes to both Git and working files.

executed_checks.check: Current builder output preserves every existing question object, including old authored_at, edition, source_boundary, read records and content hash.
Current builder output preserves every existing source object, including original checked_at and provenance.
In-memory modification of authored_at, edition, or source_boundary is rejected even when content_sha256 is recomputed.
New authoring files carry explicit 2026-10-29 date and edition; their sources use distinct IDs and 2026-10-29 read dates.

code_findings.finding_ko: 이미 등록된 source ID의 병합 분기는 URL 확인 후 exact_sections/verification_scope를 합치고 continue하므로, 뒤에 있는 checked_at·access_status·retrieval_method 검증이 두 번째 입력에 실행되지 않는다. 서로 다른 확인일을 가진 재조회 자료가 향후 같은 ID를 재사용하면 두 번째 날짜/출처 정보가 무시될 수 있다.
code_findings.current_impact_ko: 이번 authoring 파일 4개에는 source ID 충돌이 없고 기존 45개 source 객체의 완전 해시 보호가 작동하므로, 현재 11개 추가안이나 기존 46개를 바꾸는 문제는 관찰하지 못했다.
code_findings.suggestion_ko: 후속 입력에서도 각 source record를 먼저 검증한 뒤 병합하거나, 다른 확인일·조회방법은 별도 source ID로 기록하도록 명시적으로 거부한다. 기존 객체를 바꾸는 병합은 현재 baseline guard가 계속 막아야 한다.
code_findings.resolution_ko: 모든 source record의 공식 호스트·HTTPS·확인일·READ_OFFICIAL·범위/조회방법 검증이 충돌 분기보다 먼저 실행된다. 동일 ID의 checked_at, access_status, retrieval_method, source_currency가 다르면 별도 ID를 요구한다. 일치하는 동일 출처의 조항 범위 병합은 남기되, 기존 공개 source 객체 변경은 baseline guard가 계속 거부한다.

reviewed_design_decisions: Original files alone receive the old metadata fallback; later authoring files must explicitly provide date and date-matching edition.
Each question retains its author-file date and edition; cumulative bank updated_at and edition may advance without changing published objects.
The ledger keeps original triage reviewed_at and NOT_REVERIFIED findings while separately adding implementation_updated_at.
The lexical candidate report date follows bank.updated_at and makes no new semantic or legal-verification claim.
The new disposition test fixes the set of 12 targeted original IDs while allowing replacement, hold, or reuse; it does not require 12 newly authored cases.
Existing archive byte checks, immutable previous96 checks, history/Chaos contracts, and independent-audit-null checks remain present.
limitations: The full pytest and real-HTTP Playwright suites were not run in this code review. Parent integration/CI will provide their results.
Question legal keys, distractors and authority sufficiency are not certified by these mechanical preservation checks.
The reported hashes identify the exact reviewed code snapshot; later edits require review or an addendum.

extra_in_memory_negative_probes.message: rw-cmr3: conflicting source_currency; record a distinct source ID

edition_test_addendum.reason: The publisher intentionally copies author edition to source_edition and assigns the delivery/publication edition to the public record. The updated test checks both edition layers and the unchanged source-bank edition separately.

final_authoring_freeze_recheck.note: This final authoring disposition supersedes the earlier 11-case provisional count; the historical code-validation probes remain recorded above.
